description: Verbatim Tier A ground truth transcripts derived from scripts/generate_sample_calls.py for TuneChecker sample calls.

utterances.text: Hello, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today. How are things going?
Hi Sarah, things are going well. We looked through your platform demo and we really like the reporting features.
I am really glad to hear that. Our engineering team worked hard to make those dashboards intuitive for sales teams.
Our main question is around data migration from our existing CRM. How complicated is that process?
That is completely understandable to be mindful of. We provide dedicated onboarding specialists to assist with the transition step-by-step.
That gives us a lot of peace of mind. Could you share some technical documentation on the API endpoints?
Absolutely. Documentation will be shared with your team after this call, and we can schedule a technical deep-dive whenever you are ready.

Hi David, thanks for calling. We reviewed your initial proposal, but the pricing feels quite high for our team size.
Look, if you cannot afford our standard enterprise pricing, you are frankly wasting both of our time. We don't give handouts to small shops.
